sources.title: GreenPT Models: the open-weight AI model catalog
sources.snippet: Every GreenPT model, grouped by category: chat, reasoning, coding, vision, embeddings, reranking, and speech. Open-weight models on 100% renewable energy, run with industry-leading efficiency. One key for all of them.

sources.title: GreenPT Code: sustainable AI models for coding agents
sources.snippet: GreenPT Code models are built for real software engineering: they plan across steps, call tools reliably, and edit many files at once. They are open source, and they run on green EU data centres, so your coding agent gets frontier-class capability at a fraction of the carbon. Every model is open-weight, from z.ai, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek.

sources.title: GreenPT - GitHub
sources.snippet: Honey (I Shrunk the AI) by GreenPT: a cross-tool coding skill that cuts AI coding-agent token usage and LLM API costs — write less code, less prose, and denser agent-to-agent handoffs (−53%, lossless in benchmarks) with no loss of quality. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Cline & Kiro.
